import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import fsolve

n = 150000
fwd_target = 10.0
bwd_target = 10.0

# With U uniform (1/n):
#   KL(P||U) = log n - H(P)                 => H(P) = log n - 10
#   KL(U||P) = -log n - mean(log p)         => mean(log p) = -log n - 10
Ht = np.log(n) - fwd_target
Lt = -np.log(n) - bwd_target
print("target entropy  H* =", repr(Ht))
print("target mean log L* =", repr(Lt))

k = 7          # 7 "large" states: 6 equal to a, 1 equal to c
m = n - k      # remaining tiny states, each b

def eqs(x):
    a, c, b = np.exp(x)
    s = 6.0*a + c + m*b
    H = -(6.0*a*np.log(a) + c*np.log(c) + m*b*np.log(b))
    L = (6.0*np.log(a) + np.log(c) + m*np.log(b))/n
    return [s - 1.0, H - Ht, L - Lt]

guess = np.log([0.1555, 0.067, 3.03e-10])
sol, info, ier, msg = fsolve(eqs, guess, full_output=True, xtol=1e-14)
print("ier:", ier, msg)
a, c, b = np.exp(sol)
print("a, c, b =", a, c, b)
print("residuals:", eqs(sol))

p = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
p[:6] = a
p[6] = c
p[7:] = b
p = p / p.sum()          # exact enumeration normalization

def kl_metrics(p):
    logp = np.log(p)
    logu = -np.log(len(p))
    fwd = float(np.sum(p * (logp - logu)))
    bwd = float(np.mean(logu - logp))
    return fwd, bwd

fwd, bwd = kl_metrics(p)
print("p.sum() =", p.sum())
print("min p =", p.min(), "max p =", p.max(), "finite:", np.all(np.isfinite(p)), "all>0:", np.all(p > 0))
print("forward KL = %.15f (target 10, err %.3e)" % (fwd, abs(fwd-10)))
print("backward KL = %.15f (target 10, err %.3e)" % (bwd, abs(bwd-10)))
print("entropy = %.15f  meanlog = %.15f" % (-np.sum(p*np.log(p)), np.mean(np.log(p))))

assert np.all(np.isfinite(p)) and np.all(p > 0)
assert abs(p.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-12
assert abs(fwd - 10.0) <= 1e-3 and abs(bwd - 10.0) <= 1e-3

np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)
print("saved /app/dist.npy  shape/dtype:", p.shape, p.dtype)
